newsitem.title: JAPAN: Russia's Almaz to close Tokyo office by early Sept.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Almaz to close Tokyo office by early Sept.

text.p: Russia's platinum group metals export agency Almazjuvelirexport is to close its Tokyo office by early September, the agency's representative in Tokyo said on Monday.
"We're going to close the Tokyo office by early September. I don't know any details of the reason," the representative said. "It may be part of a reorganisation."
Russia is the world's largest supplier of palladium and the second-largest of platinum, while Japan is the leading consumer of both white metals.
Almaz established its Tokyo office in 1972.

The agency resumed shipments of palladium and platinum to Japan last week after a lapse of about six months. The Russian delay in shipments fuelled price rallies and prompted market talk that Russian stockpiles could be dwindling.
